name: ORBDA (openEHR benchmark dataset)
description: An openEHR-format benchmark dataset designed to assess the performance of electronic health record servers.
reputation: A niche benchmark used primarily in health informatics research for evaluating openEHR server implementations; moderate recognition within the EHR benchmarking community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on server performance. Dataset emphasizes benchmarking of openEHR servers (throughput/latency) rather than clinical modeling; may contain synthetic or de-identified records and has limited clinical diversity. Not intended for training language models; potential privacy/usage constraints depending on data provenance.
